Bubble Clock with Photo Frame A101 – Stylish Digital Desk Clock with 3 LCD Displays

The Bubble Clock with Photo Frame A101 is a modern and elegant digital clock designed to add both functionality and style to your living or work space. Featuring a beautiful circular bubble design with three independent LCD displays, this clock clearly shows the date, time, and temperature in separate circles, making it easy to read at a glance.

Designed for versatility, the Bubble Clock with Photo Frame A101 also works as a customizable photo frame. You can easily change the picture inside, allowing you to display cherished memories, branding visuals, or inspirational images. This makes it an excellent choice for homes, offices, reception desks, bedside tables, and corporate gifting.

Modern Circle Design with Triple LCD Display

The standout feature of this digital desk clock is its unique bubble-style circular layout. Each LCD screen is dedicated to a specific function—time, date, and temperature—ensuring clarity without clutter. Unlike ordinary digital clocks, the Bubble Clock with Photo Frame A101 combines modern aesthetics with practical usability, making it a perfect accompaniment to any table or flat surface.

Customizable Photo Frame – Easy Picture Change

This digital clock with photo frame allows you to quickly replace the displayed image without tools or technical steps. Whether you want to personalize your workspace or gift something meaningful, the offers a thoughtful and stylish solution. It is also popular as a promotional product and branded desk accessory.

Advanced Alarm Features with Countdown Timer

Equipped with a built-in countdown timer and 9 different music alarm modes, this clock ensures you never miss an important task or appointment. The multiple alarm tones allow you to choose the sound that best suits your routine, whether for waking up, reminders, or work breaks.

Battery Operated for Flexible Placement

The runs on 2 x AAA batteries (not included), eliminating the need for constant power supply or messy cables. This battery-operated digital clock can be placed anywhere—office desks, bedside tables, shelves, or reception counters—without restrictions.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Elegant bubble circle design with three LCD displays
  • Shows time, date, and temperature simultaneously
  • Customizable photo frame with easy picture replacement
  • 9 music alarm modes for personalized alerts
  • Built-in countdown timer for daily reminders
  • Clear digital display for day and night visibility
  • Perfect accompaniment to office tables and bedside desks
  • Works on 2 x AAA batteries (not included)

Ideal for Home, Office & Gifting

Whether you are looking for a digital alarm clock for your bedroom, a stylish desk clock for your office, or a unique gift item, the fits every need. Its modern design complements contemporary interiors, while its practical features make it suitable for everyday use.

This LCD clock with temperature display is especially popular among professionals, students, and businesses seeking functional yet decorative accessories. With its combination of design, technology, and personalization, it stands out from standard digital clocks.

Why Choose?

The offers a perfect balance of aesthetics and performance. From its triple LCD display and customizable to its multiple alarm tones and battery-operated convenience, every detail is designed for comfort and usability. If you are searching for a reliable, modern, and visually appealing digital clock, this product is an excellent choice.
